name: DURANGO HOME SAUNA
description:
The Durango Far Infrared Sauna home sauna kit is very popular with families who want to enjoy their sauna sessions together. This luxurious 3-person sauna boasts the highest quality, hand crafted workmanship, including upgraded LED Chromotherapy Lights, large high quality heating panels, and safety glass door.

The Durango is the perfect health retreat, which uses a time tested, effective therapy in achieving your optimal wellness. Detoxify, lose weight, relieve pain and strengthen your immune system with the Durango infrared sauna.  

Large enough for stretching and calm yoga poses for one person, the Durango provides comfortable seating for up to 3 people!

Featured Durango shown in optional Red Cedar.
